info.name: Hospigo 6a investigations bill, refunds and cancelling
info.description: Step 6a (API): tests ordered by the doctor, the investigations bill, refund requests, Admin approval and cancelling a waiting visit. BEFORE RUNNING: (1) npm run prisma:migrate -w @hospigo/api  (2) re-run the dev seed so the roles get the new permissions: NODE_ENV=development npm run prisma:seed -w @hospigo/api  (3) start the API on port 3000. Select the Hospigo Local environment (staffPassword and superadminPassword). Then Run collection. About 5 logins count against the login IP limit (20 per minute). Every request has checks; all of them should be green. Re-running creates new patients and visits.

item.name: 0 Setup
1 Login Receptionist (north main)

exec: pm.test('select the Hospigo Local environment: staffPassword and superadminPassword must be set', () => { pm.expect(pm.variables.get('staffPassword'), 'staffPassword').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.variables.get('superadminPassword'), 'superadminPassword').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: 2 Login Doctor 2 (north main)
3 Login Nurse (north main)
4 Login SuperAdmin (north main): decides refunds
5 Login South Receptionist (other hospital)
1 Doctor orders tests, reception bills them
6 Pick Doctor North 2

exec: pm.test('Doctor North 2 exists and is available', () => { pm.expect(d).to.exist; pm.expect(d.available).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 7 Register patient A
8 Reception takes payment: visit 1

exec: pm.test('paid visit is WAITING with a token and a paid consultation bill', () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('WAITING'); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(j.bill.paymentStatus).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(j.bill.totalPaise).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: 9 Doctor searches the tests list (no prices)

exec: pm.test('no price is sent to the doctor', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(items)).to.not.match(/price|paise/i));

item.name: 10 Ordering before the consultation starts is refused (409)
11 Doctor 2 starts visit 1
12 The nurse cannot order tests (403)
13 Reception cannot order tests (403)
14 Doctor 2 orders two tests

exec: pm.test('two tests, both ORDERED', () => { pm.expect(o).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(o.every(x => x.status === 'ORDERED')).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 15 The same test twice in one list is refused (400)
16 Reception sees the pending tests with current prices

exec: pm.test('the visit is on the list with two priced tests', () => { pm.expect(row).to.exist; pm.expect(row.orders).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(row.orders.every(o => o.pricePaise > 0)).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('the total is the sum of the prices', () => pm.expect(row.totalPaise).to.eql(row.orders[0].pricePaise + row.orders[1].pricePaise));

item.name: 17 The nurse cannot see the pending tests (403)
18 A changed total is refused: 409 PRICE_CHANGED, nothing charged
19 The doctor cannot bill (403)
20 Reception bills both tests: cash + UPI, ONE receipt

exec: pm.test('an investigations bill, paid in full', () => { pm.expect(j.bill.billType).to.eql('INVESTIGATION'); pm.expect(j.bill.paymentStatus).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(j.bill.totalPaise).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('pTestsTotal'))); });
pm.test('two test lines, ONE receipt, two payments', () => { pm.expect(j.bill.lines).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(j.bill.receipts).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(j.bill.payments).to.have.length(2); });
pm.test('both orders are BILLED', () => pm.expect(j.orders.every(o => o.status === 'BILLED')).to.eql(true));

item.name: 21 The same key again returns the same bill (200)

exec: pm.test('replayed: same bill and receipt', () => { pm.expect(j.replayed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.bill.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('pTestsBill')); pm.expect(j.bill.receipts[0].receiptNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('pReceiptNumber')); });

item.name: 22 The same key for something else is refused (409)
23 A billed test cannot be billed again (409)
24 The doctor cannot change a billed test list (the billed tests stay)

exec: pm.test('both tests are still there, BILLED', () => { const o = pm.response.json().orders; pm.expect(o).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(o.every(x => x.status === 'BILLED')).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 25 Reception sees the tests and the investigations bill

exec: pm.test('one investigations bill with its receipt', () => { pm.expect(j.bills).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(j.bills[0].billNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('pTestsBillNumber')); });

item.name: 26 The doctor sees the tests but never money

exec: pm.test('orders yes, bills no', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.orders).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(j.bills).to.be.undefined; });

item.name: 27 Another hospital's receptionist cannot see this visit (404)
28 No token = 401
2 Refunds and cancelling a visit
29 Register patient B
30 Reception takes payment: visit 2 (will be refunded, then cancelled)

exec: pm.test('paid visit is WAITING with a token and a paid consultation bill', () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('WAITING'); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(j.bill.paymentStatus).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(j.bill.totalPaise).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: 31 Receptionist asks for 100 rupees back (nothing moves yet)

exec: pm.test('REQUESTED, 10000 paise, original bill unchanged', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('REQUESTED'); pm.expect(r.type).to.eql('REFUND'); pm.expect(r.amountPaise).to.eql(10000); pm.expect(r.bill.refundedPaise).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 32 The same key returns the same request (200)

exec: pm.test('same request', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.replayed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.request.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('pReq1')); });

item.name: 33 More than was paid is refused (409)
34 Zero or negative amounts are refused (400)
35 The receptionist cannot approve her own request (403)
36 The SuperAdmin cannot ask for refunds (403)
37 The SuperAdmin lists the open requests

exec: pm.test('the request is on the list, all are REQUESTED', () => { pm.expect(items.every(i => i.status === 'REQUESTED')).to.eql(true); pm.expect(items.map(i => i.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('pReq1')); });

item.name: 38 Another hospital cannot see the request (404)
39 The SuperAdmin approves: refund in the original mode, voucher number issued

exec: pm.test('APPROVED with a voucher number', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('APPROVED'); pm.expect(r.refundNumber).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('one refund of 10000 paise in CASH (the original mode)', () => { pm.expect(r.refunds).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(r.refunds[0].amountPaise).to.eql(10000); pm.expect(r.refunds[0].paymentMode.code).to.eql('CASH'); });
pm.test('the bill shows the refund, the original amounts are unchanged', () => { pm.expect(r.bill.refundedPaise).to.eql(10000); pm.expect(r.bill.paidPaise).to.eql(r.bill.totalPaise); });
pm.test('a refund alone does not cancel the visit', () => pm.expect(r.visit.status).to.eql('WAITING'));

item.name: 40 Approving the same request again gives the same answer, money moves once

exec: pm.test('replayed, still one refund', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.replayed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.request.refunds).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(j.request.bill.refundedPaise).to.eql(10000); });

item.name: 41 Reception asks to CANCEL visit 2 (default: all that is left)

exec: pm.test('CANCEL_VISIT for what is still refundable', () => { pm.expect(r.type).to.eql('CANCEL_VISIT'); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('REQUESTED'); pm.expect(r.amountPaise).to.eql(total - 10000); });

item.name: 42 A second open cancellation is refused (409)
43 The visit is still waiting until the Admin decides
44 The SuperAdmin approves the cancellation

exec: pm.test('APPROVED, visit CANCELLED, the whole fee has been returned', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('APPROVED'); pm.expect(r.visit.status).to.eql('CANCELLED'); pm.expect(r.bill.refundedPaise).to.eql(r.bill.paidPaise); });

item.name: 45 The cancelled visit is gone from the doctor queue

exec: pm.test('visit 2 is not in the queue', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.map(i => i.id)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('pVisit2')));

item.name: 46 A cancelled visit cannot be started (409)
47 Nothing more can be refunded on it (409)
48 Visit 1 is in consultation: its consultation fee can no longer be refunded (409)
49 ...and it cannot be cancelled either (409)
50 But the tests bill CAN be refunded after the consultation started (ask for all of it)
51 Approving without the UPI reference is refused (400): the UPI part needs one
52 A reference that is not text is refused (400), not a crash
53 With the reference it works: every payment gets its own money back

exec: const by = m => r.refunds.filter(x => x.paymentMode.code === m).reduce((s, x) => s + x.amountPaise, 0);
pm.test('CASH 30000 back to cash, the rest back to UPI', () => { pm.expect(by('CASH')).to.eql(30000); pm.expect(by('UPI')).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('pTestsTotal')) - 30000); });

pm.test('the whole tests bill is refunded; the receipt/bill amounts are unchanged', () => { pm.expect(r.bill.refundedPaise).to.eql(r.bill.paidPaise); pm.expect(r.bill.totalPaise).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get('pTestsTotal'))); });

item.name: 54 Nothing is left to refund on the tests bill (409)
55 Register patient C
56 Reception takes payment: visit 3 (cancellation will be rejected)

exec: pm.test('paid visit is WAITING with a token and a paid consultation bill', () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('WAITING'); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(j.bill.paymentStatus).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(j.bill.totalPaise).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: 57 Reception asks to cancel visit 3
58 Rejecting needs a note (400)
59 The SuperAdmin rejects with a note

exec: pm.test('REJECTED with the note, no voucher, no money moved', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('REJECTED'); pm.expect(r.decisionNote).to.eql('Patient is still here'); pm.expect(r.refundNumber).to.eql(null); pm.expect(r.refunds).to.have.length(0); pm.expect(r.bill.refundedPaise).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 60 A rejected request cannot be approved afterwards (409)
61 Visit 3 is still waiting in the queue
62 The closed request list shows approved and rejected ones

exec: pm.test('all four requests of this run are listed', () => ['pReq1','pReqCancel','pReqTests','pReqReject'].forEach(k => pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get(k))));

item.name: 63 No token = 401
